# Donate to DumpSock

DumpSock is **free, open-source, and will stay that way forever**.

There is no "pro" tier. There is no paid upgrade. There is no feature you'll
unlock by donating. Every line of code is Apache 2.0, every release is
signed, every binary is reproducible from the public source.

If DumpSock saved you an iCloud subscription, recovered storage you needed,
or just made you smile a little — you can drop us something below. **It's
voluntary, it's appreciated, and it's never expected.**

All donations go to **HARTLE.TECH** (the Portuguese company behind DumpSock,
NIPC `518241327`). They fund:

- DumpSock's continued development (more platforms, more device support)
- Other free, local-first tools we ship under the HARTLE.TECH umbrella
- Coffee (let's be honest)

## Where you can support us

The list below is roughly **ordered by lowest fees to highest**. Pick
whichever is easiest for you — we appreciate them all equally.

| Platform | Best for | Fees | Recurring? |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Liberapay](#liberapay) | EU users, set-and-forget recurring | 0% from Liberapay; payment processor (~3%) | weekly / monthly / yearly |
| [GitHub Sponsors](#github-sponsors) | GitHub users, one-click | 0% (GitHub covers processing) | one-time + monthly |
| [Ko-fi](#ko-fi) | One-time "tip jar" feel | 0% on one-time, 5% on monthly | both |
| [Buy Me a Coffee](#buy-me-a-coffee) | Broadest reach, simple checkout | 5% + payment processor | both |
| [Direct bank / Stripe](#direct-stripe) | Larger one-off or sponsorship deals | ~1.4% + €0.25 (EU cards) | both |

::: tip
**Service status**: as DumpSock grows, we'll add accounts and link them here.
Each entry in the table above goes live as the underlying account is created.
If a link below says "coming soon", we haven't set that one up yet — the
others still work.
:::

---

## Liberapay {#liberapay}

[Liberapay](https://liberapay.com/) is a **non-profit, fee-free** recurring
donation platform built specifically for free-software maintainers. Liberapay
itself takes 0% — your bank or card processor takes the usual small fee, and
that's it.

- **Recurring**: weekly, monthly, or yearly
- **Anonymous donations supported** if you don't want to log in
- **EU-friendly**: based in France, SEPA direct debit available for €0 fees

→ **HARTLE.TECH on Liberapay**: _coming soon_

## GitHub Sponsors {#github-sponsors}

[GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors) is the most-integrated
option. Once it's set up, every DumpSock repo shows a "Sponsor" button and
GitHub passes 100% of your donation to us — they cover the Stripe fees
themselves.

- **One-time or monthly**
- **Visible recognition**: sponsors get a small icon next to their name in
  GitHub PRs and issues (optional)
- **Lowest friction for GitHub users**: one click from any DumpSock issue

→ **HARTLE.TECH on GitHub Sponsors**: _coming soon (pending approval)_

## Ko-fi {#ko-fi}

[Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/) is the indie-creator "tip jar" of choice. One-time
tips have **0% platform fee** (only payment-processor fees apply). Monthly
memberships have a small 5% platform fee.

- **Instant**: no application, no waiting
- **One-time or monthly**
- **Optional message**: tell us what DumpSock saved for you

→ **HARTLE.TECH on Ko-fi**: _coming soon_

## Buy Me a Coffee {#buy-me-a-coffee}

[Buy Me a Coffee](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/) is the most mainstream
"tip" platform — the page looks polished, the checkout is fast, your
relatives will recognize the brand. There's a 5% platform fee plus card
processing.

- **One-time or monthly**
- **Custom amounts** or fixed "tier" amounts
- **Recurring rewards** if we ever set up paid memberships (we haven't and
  probably won't — DumpSock will stay free)

→ **HARTLE.TECH on Buy Me a Coffee**: _coming soon_

## Direct bank / Stripe {#direct-stripe}

For **larger one-off donations**, **company sponsorships**, or anyone who'd
rather avoid third-party platforms entirely, we accept Stripe direct payments
through a branded hosted page (or, for SEPA / wire transfer, just email us
for an invoice).

This route has the **lowest fees** (~1.4% + €0.25 per EU card) and the money
goes directly to HARTLE.TECH's business account without a platform
intermediary.

→ **donate.hartle.tech**: _coming soon_
→ **For invoices, SEPA, or wire**: <contact@hartle.tech>

---

## What we won't do with donations

- **No "donor exclusive" features.** Everyone gets every feature.
- **No paywalled documentation.** Every doc page is and will stay public.
- **No "donate to remove the ad"** — there are no ads.
- **No telemetry phoning home** asking "would you like to donate?". DumpSock
  doesn't phone home at all.
- **No selling our donor list.** Your email and name stay with the platform
  you donated through; we don't import them anywhere.

## What we will do with donations

- Pay for the laptops + iPhones we test new releases against.
- Pay for the (modest) cloud spend that hosts this docs site and our CI.
- Pay for the time it takes to add Android-via-MTP support, more iOS
  versions, broader codec coverage, and the next thing in our backlog.
- Buy each maintainer one (1) coffee per month.

## Thank you

Whether you donate or not, **just using DumpSock and telling a friend** is
enormously appreciated. The best donation is a non-cloud iPhone backup
story. Email <contact@hartle.tech> if DumpSock helped you — it makes our
week, every time.

— The HARTLE.TECH team
